run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum number of segments of lengths a, b, c that fit into length n
test_f_gold: test f_gold with sample parameters to verify the dynamic programming segment maximization logic
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a DP array to compute maximum segment cuts for length n
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the max segments of sizes a, b, c fitting into n or -1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the DP approach with a recursive or greedy segment cutting strategy
